name: Inerrancy Of The Bible
overview: Scripture reveals the inerrancy of God's Word by emphasizing its purity, truth, and enduring nature. The Psalms affirm that the words of the LORD are refined and pure, likened to silver purified seven times, and true from the very beginning. Proverbs highlights that every word of God is pure and serves as a shield for those who trust Him. Isaiah assures that while earthly things fade, the Word of God stands forever, and Jesus Himself affirms in Matthew that life is sustained by every word from God's mouth, with even the smallest details of the law remaining unaltered until fulfilled. Together, these verses affirm the perfect reliability and eternal preservation of Scripture.
